llm.summary: This is a documented Go client integration for Mem0 that clearly discloses external API use, credentials, and mutable hosted-resource operations.

dimensions.detail: The skill may guide edits to the current Go project and sends memory content, queries, metadata, and Authorization credentials to https://api.mem0.ai when user code calls the client; this is disclosed and proportionate for a hosted API SDK.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Installation is a standard Go module fetch via go get github.com/psyb0t/go-mem0, with network access disclosed for module retrieval and runtime Mem0 API calls.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime guidance is scoped to installing and using the Go package, reading the API key from MEM0_API_KEY, checking HTTP status fields, and keeping entity/organization filters explicit; no prompt override, hidden instruction, or automatic action was found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: The referenced API includes high-impact hosted mutations and deletes, including bulk memory, organization, project, member, and webhook deletion, but the skill warns to perform such operations only on task-owned resources when requested and contains no local persistence, services, or executable payload.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The skill purpose is to help Go projects use an unofficial typed Mem0 Platform API client; its described capabilities match that purpose, including memory, entity, organization, project, webhook, profile, and Dream API operations.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install this only if you intend to use Mem0's hosted API from Go. Use a least-privilege API key, keep filters scoped to the intended user/agent/app/run, and require explicit human review before calling delete or organization/project/member mutation methods.
llm.findings:
[TM1] expected: The DELETE endpoints flagged by the scanner are present in a complete generated API reference for Mem0 and are disclosed as client operations; the artifact does not instruct automatic deletion or hide destructive behavior.
[SQP-2] expected: The skill explicitly states that runtime requests send memory content, queries, metadata, and credentials to api.mem0.ai and advises scoped filters and non-logging of keys, so the external data flow is disclosed.
